sql: SELECT a1, b1 FROM (SELECT k, v FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS k, 1 AS v),('b',2),('a',3)])) PIVOT(SUM(v) FOR k IN ('a' AS a1, 'b' AS b1))
SELECT k, v FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b) UNPIVOT(v FOR k IN (a, b)) ORDER BY k
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING) AS k, SUM(v) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS k,1 AS v),('a',2),('b',3)]) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k) ORDER BY k
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING) AS k, CAST(g AS STRING) AS g, SUM(v) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS k,'x' AS g,1 AS v),('a','y',2),('b','x',3)]) GROUP BY CUBE(k, g) ORDER BY k, g
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING) AS k, SUM(v) AS s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS k,1 AS v),('b',2)]) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS(k, ()) ORDER BY k
WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM t WHERE n < 3) SELECT n FROM t ORDER BY n
SELECT v FROM UNNEST([1,1,2,2,3]) AS v ORDER BY v LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (10 PERCENT)
note: nondeterministic random sample; safety.nondeterministic() flags it but translate accepts it to DuckDB USING SAMPLE -> differential compares a random result. Must be not_run.

sql: SELECT JSON_EXTRACT('{"a":1}', '$.a') AS v
SELECT JSON_VALUE('{"a":"x"}', '$.a') AS v
SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a":{"b":2}}', '$.a') AS v
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(1 AS a, 2 AS b)) AS v
note: coverage gap; also the only way to render SELECT AS STRUCT/VALUE

sql: SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(t) AS v FROM (SELECT AS STRUCT 1 AS a, 2 AS b) t
SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(x) AS v FROM UNNEST([1,1,2,3,3]) AS x
note: maps to verified APPROX_DISTINCT and is compared EXACTLY; HLL differs across engines on real data. Must be not_run or approximate-aware.

sql: SELECT CAST(APPROX_QUANTILES(x, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS STRING) AS v FROM UNNEST([1,2,3,4,5]) AS x
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-03-10 09:30:00+00' AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS v
SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '2024-03-10 09:30:00+00', INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS STRING) AS v
SELECT CAST(INTERVAL 90 MINUTE AS STRING) AS v
note: INTERVAL-typed result renders differently: BigQuery '0-0 0 1:30:0' vs DuckDB '01:30:00'

sql: SELECT CAST(DATE '2024-01-01' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS STRING) AS v
note: DATE+INTERVAL widens to DATETIME in BOTH BigQuery and DuckDB here

sql: SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2024-01-15 00:00:00', DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', WEEK) AS v
SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 12:00:00+00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 09:30:00+00', HOUR) AS v
SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2024-03-31 00:00:00', DATETIME '2024-01-31 00:00:00', MONTH) AS v
